subject: Standby queue authorization request — AtlasAI deal
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasai.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Standby queue authorization request — AtlasAI deal

Hi Samira / Atlas procurement team,

Congrats again on a great demo last week — the Atlas inference benchmarks look solid. We're in late-stage alignment on the Dedicated contract for the POC -> production ramp and want to make sure we can guarantee capacity for your initial launch window. Quick ask: can we place a soft standby reservation on the West US GPU pool to cover AtlasAI's June/July ramp?

Request summary:
- Requested hold: equivalent of 6x H100 (or 12x A100-80GB equivalent) for 60 days starting June 10, 2028
- Intended usage: model training cache + steady-state production inference (peak 220K tokens/min, 4 concurrent workers)
- Preferred region: west-us (closer to your prod VPC)
- Hold type: soft standby (no immediate billing; 30-day soft hold with option to convert to reserved capacity, see attached)

Why this matters now:
- We expect a 4–6 week procurement review; holding the slots reduces risk of capacity churn during your negotiation window.
- If another customer needs transient burst capacity we can offer a fallback variant (smaller instance mix) but want to avoid moving your traffic mid-ramp.

Attachments: capacity_hold_form.pdf (form + proposed terms)

Next steps: If you confirm acceptance of the soft standby terms we will:
1) Add a temporary hold in our capacity ledger dated June 10
2) Reserve the exact hardware mix and publish an inventory snapshot to the deal (cc: Karthik for inventory)
3) Share a short mutual action plan and DocuSign link for conversion if you want a committed reserve

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-min call today if helpful.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123


From: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>, DevOps <devops@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby queue authorization request — AtlasAI deal

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear ask. A few quick procurement questions before we sign off internally:

- Does the soft standby incur any fee while it is in the 30-day soft hold state? If so, please quantify.
- What are the exact SLA/termination options if we decide not to convert to a commit? We need a clear cutover policy for billing and data retention.
- Can you confirm the hardware mix (H100 vs A100) and whether we can mix instance types as a contingency?

CCing our DevOps (devops@atlasai.com) to verify region preference. They may request West US2 instead of West US — would that materially affect the hold?

Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships | AtlasAI
samira.k@atlasai.com


On Fri, Jun 1, 2028 at 11:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan / Samira — inventory snapshot and suggested safety profile below.
>
> Quick inventory note (as of 2028-06-01 08:45 PDT):
> - West US pool: 24x H100 available immediately, 8x H100 pending (maintenance window 6/12-6/13)
> - West US2 pool: 10x H100 available, mixed A100 pool has 30x A100 available
>
> Recommendation for AtlasAI:
> 1) Place a soft standby hold for 6x H100 in West US2 (balances availability and fewer maintenance conflicts).
> 2) Soft hold policy: 30-day no-charge hold, conversion requires signed commitment (30/60/90-day terms available). If we convert, billing starts on conversion date.
> 3) Fallback options: if H100s are constrained we can run 12x A100-80GB across two racks with ~10% latency impact; Ops will work with Atlas devs on tuning.
>
> Attached: inventory_snapshot.csv (pool-level counts + maintenance windows).
>
> Operational caveat: West US will undergo a small capacity shuffle the week of 6/12 for a firmware rollout; if Atlas needs strict lock we should avoid scheduling conversion during that week.
>

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasai.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby queue authorization request — AtlasAI deal

Samira — thanks for the quick turnaround and great questions. To answer directly:

- Soft hold fee: none for the first 30 days. If the hold extends beyond 30 days without conversion we apply a nominal 5% monthly standby fee to cover reservation opportunity cost (details in attached form).
- SLA/termination: soft hold is non-binding; conversion triggers the standard Dedicated SLA with a 99.9% uptime target. Early termination after conversion follows the contract termination clauses (we'll mark this in the DocuSign).
- Hardware mix: Karthik suggests West US2 H100s to avoid the maintenance window; we can offer a mixed A100 fallback with performance guidance. You will have the option to split the hold across H100 and A100 variants in the conversion form.

Action items I propose:
1) Atlas to confirm region (West US vs West US2) and acceptance of soft hold terms (reply-all).
2) Redwood to apply the soft hold effective June 10 and upload inventory snapshot to HubSpot (I will add the DocuSign link).
3) If procurement needs an internal quote, I'll ask Finance to produce a provisional quote for committed conversion options (30/60/90 days).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ATLAS-1492
DocuSign (conversion template): https://redwood.docusign.com/12345

I can schedule a 15-min alignment call at 3pm PT if that helps — open to calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan


From: Samira Khan <samira.k@atlasai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>, DevOps <devops@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby queue authorization request — AtlasAI deal

Jordan / Karthik —

We accept the soft hold under the terms you described (30 days free hold, conversion via DocuSign). Please apply the standby to West US2 and confirm in writing when the hold is in the ledger. Procurement will review the conversion template tomorrow morning; we expect to convert to a 60-day commit if pricing looks good.

Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships | AtlasAI
